ModMetaData.name: Test Harness — Static Patches
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description: Patches that do NOT change between test runs. Exercises CASE 3 (sequence sibling — a sequence that bundles a dirty def with an unrelated sibling) and CASE 5 (conditional branch flip — branch taken depends on a field added by TestMod_Change). No game content — dev/QA use only.
